name: Isometric height & jump
oneLiner: A 2:1 isometric tactics map where every tile has a height: units climb at most their jump, shoot farther from high ground, hit harder from above or behind, choose a facing when done, and act in wait-time order; blocks in front hide units behind them, which get an outline.
fits: grid tactics that wants terrain height
dungeon tactics with stairs and ledges
notFor: games whose units must stay on a flat top-down view

needs: tile grid size, height level per tile, terrain kind per tile
unit list {x, y, hp, side} with move, jump and range stats (or defaults)
a unit draw function that can draw at given feet coordinates
a fixed-step update (60 Hz) and the map viewport rect
input: cursor tile (two-way), pointer position, confirm / cancel keys
provides: data projection tile <-> screen px and picking with height
data reachable / stoppable / attack sets under the jump rule
data damage multiplier (height and facing: front / side / back)
data unit anchors (drawn sprite box on the iso map)
data UI rects (info plate, WT bar, cursor)
event next unit by wait time

params.label: Default jump (levels a unit can climb)
Extra levels a unit may drop
Facing at the end of an action

assets: none: blocks, water, units, backdrop, font and windows are drawn by code
